$comment: Reference tool definitions across domains, grouped by domain key. Pull the 3-7 tools your agent needs from here (see examples/customer-support-agent.json for a subset); this file is the master list.

tools.name: lookup_customer
tools.description: Find a customer record by email or customer_id. Returns name, plan, signup_date, last_active, and current account status. Use this first when the customer's identity is not yet established.

tools.name: get_account_detail
tools.description: Full account record: contacts, contract dates, MRR, recent activity. Read-only; no side effects. Requires customer_id from lookup_customer.

tools.name: add_account_note
tools.description: Add a note to a customer account. Visibility is 'team' (visible to entire org) or 'private' (visible only to the calling user). Audit logged; cannot be deleted via this tool.

tools.name: check_billing_status
tools.description: Get current billing status for a customer: subscription state (active/past_due/canceled), next charge date, last successful payment. Read-only.

tools.name: process_refund
tools.description: Issue a refund for a specific charge. REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL. The agent should propose the refund details and wait for explicit approval before submission. Not idempotent; do not retry on errors without re-confirming the customer was not already refunded.

reason.description: Brief reason for the refund (logged in audit trail)

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Search internal documentation, runbooks, and policies. Returns up to 5 relevant excerpts with title and source. Use this for any 'how do I' or 'what is our policy' question.

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Search a research paper library by keyword, author, or topic. Returns up to 10 matching papers with title, authors, year, and abstract. Use the abstract to decide which papers warrant fetching full text.

tools.name: fetch_paper_section
tools.description: Fetch a specific section of a paper by paper_id and section name. Returns text of that section. Use selectively; full papers are large.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files in a given directory path. Returns up to 100 entries with name, size, modified time, and type. Read-only.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a file. Returns text up to 100k characters; larger files return the first 100k with a truncated flag. Read-only.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write text content to a file. REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL for paths outside the agent's sandbox directory. Will create parent directories if needed. Overwrites existing files; not idempotent in the destructive sense.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file. REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL. Irreversible. Audit logged with the file's prior content if size < 1MB.

tools.name: search_tickets
tools.description: Search the ticketing system by query, status, or assignee. Returns up to 20 matching tickets with id, title, status, severity, assignee, last_updated.

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Create a new ticket. REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL. Severity must be one of the allowed enum values. Severity P0 (outage) and P1 (severe) page the on-call engineer.

tools.name: update_ticket_status
tools.description: Update the status of an existing ticket. Allowed transitions enforced server-side. Requires ticket_id from search_tickets.

comment.description: Optional comment recorded with the status change

tools.name: comment_on_ticket
tools.description: Add a comment to an existing ticket. Visible to all participants on the ticket. Audit logged.

tools.name: get_market_data
tools.description: Get current market data for a symbol. Returns last price, day change, volume, day high/low. Real-time during market hours; last close otherwise. Read-only.

tools.name: get_historical_prices
tools.description: Get historical price series for a symbol over a date range. Returns OHLCV bars at the requested timeframe. Read-only.

tools.name: get_economic_data
tools.description: Fetch a series from a public economic data source (FRED-style: GDP, CPI, unemployment, fed funds rate). Returns time series with dates and values.

tools.name: check_service_status
tools.description: Check current status of an internal service. Returns up/down state, last incident, current key metrics. Use for any 'is X working' question before searching runbooks.

tools.name: get_recent_deploys
tools.description: List deploys in the last N hours for a given service. Returns deploy_id, commit_sha, deployed_at, deployer, status. Use to correlate incidents with recent changes.

tools.name: rollback_deploy
tools.description: Roll back a service to a previous deploy by deploy_id. REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL. Triggers the deployment pipeline; result is async (use check_service_status to verify completion).
